subject: Marine Works - Grand Manan - Head Harbour
text:
Marine Works - Grand Manan - Head Harbour
Wharf repairs including bearing pile repairs at Head Harbour Wharf under structure 401 in 44 56.664N 066 55.205W, beginning 201100UTC Nov 2026. Repairs will take place Monday to Saturday during daylight hours only. Divers will be on site completing underwater inspection and repairs.
